Key Technical Concepts
FastCompactEngine extends BasicCompactionEngine (@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic); only summarize + compactIfNeeded overridden; deferral guard on meter.measure(agent.session).surfaceTokens.
Row ratio semantics: messageBudget = W - reserved, pressureBudget = messageBudget - headroomTokens, thresholdTokens = floor(min(W*thresholdRatio, pressureBudget)); live tool-schema overhead 7,661–8,259 tokens; 64KB route: W=65,535, O=32,000, budget 33,535.
Session-log API proves shadowed events stay readable: session.seq = event count; session.eventAt(seq) returns durable events incl. shadowed ones (lib/recall.mjs:108, :280 Math.min(requestedEnd, session.seq - 1)). Shadow ranges come from host compaction/summary events carrying data.shadowedRange {start,end}; ranges do not tile the log (gaps 331–427, 778–919 …), so non-shadowed turns stay live and must NOT be re-pinned (duplication rule).
Fixture bracket list: 428→9–330, 920→428–777, 1357→920–1282, 1697→1357–1569, 2109→1697–1941, 2225→2109–2067 (inverted, skipped byrange.end < range.start), 2603→2225–2583, 2900→2603–2804, 3200→2900–3039.
Reference rows = tool call + result only; an assistant/message reasoning event is never its own unit (appears as (thought seq N)); human turns live in the PINNED block.
Node built-in test harness (node:test, Node v24.19.0); zstd-framed logs (per-frame zlib.zstdDecompressSync, frame magic 4247762216, trailing partial frame at byte 3156400 ignored); log records carry their OWN seq.
